problem: Portal V2 external intelligence called /api/portal-ondernemersdata without the Netlify Identity bearer token while the server-side function requires getUser().
root_cause: The external-intelligence client used only Accept and same-origin credentials; Netlify Identity authentication is bearer-token based for this function.
correction: Acquire the active Netlify Identity JWT through the existing portal identity widget and send Authorization: Bearer <jwt> on the source API request.
regression_guard: portal-v2/tests/entrepreneur-intelligence-auth.test.mjs verifies the Authorization header and hides raw 401 status text from users.
reuse_rule: Protected Portal V2 APIs that call getUser() must use the same bearer-token contract as portal-state rather than relying on cookies alone.
